title: Build Your MVP This Weekend: A Non-Coder's Step-by-Step Guide
summary: Go from idea to live, paying-customer-ready product in one weekend — without writing code. The exact Friday-Saturday-Sunday playbook non-technical founders use to ship real MVPs.
body_markdown: That's the point. Blink is built for exactly this: you describe what you want in plain English and the app is built for you. No SQL, no deployment config, no API setup. The founders who use this playbook successfully are product managers, consultants, designers, and operators — not engineers. Blink handles the database, auth, and hosting automatically so you can focus on the product logic.
